item.title: The Nixpkgs core team has disbanded
item.description:
📝 We believe that it’s unsustainable for the team to continue, as demonstrated in part by our attrition to date. Therefore, especially with a Steering Committee election due imminently, we think the best way forward for Nixpkgs governance is to be honest about the circumstances that have made dissolving the team unavoidable, in the hopes that it may help future efforts. We consider the strong approval for the initial automation/AI policy from people with highly divergent views to be proof that it’s possible to find paths forward and make significant improvements even on seemingly intractable topics.
🔗 Read more: https://discourse.nixos.org/t/the-nixpkgs-core-team-has-disbanded/79413

item.title: NASA to keep its 48-year-old Voyager 2 probe running for yet another year
item.description:
📝 Each spacecraft initially launched with 10 instruments, and Voyager 2 is now down to only three instruments. Each Voyager spacecraft first flew past Jupiter and Saturn, taking unprecedented imagery of the planets and their moons. Voyager 2's last planetary flyby was in 1989.
🔗 Read more: https://www.space.com/space-exploration/voyager/nasa-figured-out-how-to-keep-its-48-year-old-voyager-2-probe-running-for-yet-another-year
